claims.claim: Manufacturer list prices for new 1.5 T MRI scanners in 2024-2026 range from 1.0 to 1.9 million dollars.
claims.episode_span: A typical 3-tesla MRI scanner reaches a hospital with a turnkey price between 2.8 and 4.5 million dollars once shielding, cooling, and integration are added.
claims.source_title: MRI Scanner Pricing Transparency: What Hospitals Actually Pay
claims.supporting_quote: Manufacturer list prices for new scanners in 2024–2026: Refurbished scanners typically run $1.5–2.5M for 3T and $700K–1.2M for 1.5T.

claims.claim: Hyperfine Swoop portable MRI systems have sold more than 100 units at roughly 250,000 dollars each.
claims.episode_span: Hyperfine, founded by Jonathan Rothberg, has shipped more than one hundred Swoop portable scanners at roughly 250,000 dollars each, twenty times less than a conventional 1.5-tesla system.
claims.supporting_quote: Hyperfine has sold more than 100 of the Swoop scanners, at roughly $250,000 apiece

claims.claim: In a remote Ontario hospital, portable MRI reduced per-patient costs from 26,105 dollars to 9,008 dollars and saved 854,841 dollars for 50 patients in one year.
claims.episode_span: In a remote Canadian hospital the portable unit cut per-patient imaging costs from 26,105 dollars to 9,008 dollars largely by eliminating air transport; the one-year saving for fifty patients reached 854,841 dollars.
claims.source_title: Feasibility and Cost Analysis of Portable MRI Implementation in a Remote Setting in Canada
claims.supporting_quote: Cost savings were $854,841 based on 50 patients receiving portable MRI over 1 year.
